## Inventions

- Method for adaptive matching of LDPC coding rate and data modulation parameters. Patent RU 2866894. 2026. [PDF](../assets/patents/ldpc-rate-modulation-adaptation.pdf)
- Method for compensating frequency and phase mismatch in a receive path. Patent RU 2858326. 2026. [PDF](../assets/patents/frequency-phase-mismatch-compensation.pdf)
- Channel estimation method in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing data transmission systems using Compressed Sensing. Patent RU 2858294. 2026. [PDF](../assets/patents/ofdm-compressed-sensing-channel-estimation.pdf)
- Method for forming a radio frame structure with adaptive placement of pilot symbols. Patent RU 2862272. 2026. [PDF](../assets/patents/adaptive-pilot-radio-frame.pdf)
- Radiometric receiver for low-intensity noise signals. Patent RU 2848653. 2025. [PDF](../assets/patents/radiometric-receiver-low-intensity-noise.pdf)
